summary: Frustrated after repeated truncated outputs despite multiple asks
detailed_context: Nick asked for a 'full polished email' — AI delivered truncated content (cut off mid-sentence). He asked again ('Give me the full version again') — AI delivered truncated content AGAIN. Now he's asking a third time with a terse redirect: 'Complete this thread.' This is a clear pattern of repeated failure to deliver the complete work as requested. Terse follow-up after multiple identical failures signals strong frustration. The AI needs to actually output the COMPLETE email, not another partial version.
